name: Even Percussion
description: Every note at a steady velocity and a short trigger length.

name: Four Voice Chords
description: Four voices, retaining the most recently played chord tones.

name: Left Hand Bass
description: Only the lower keyboard, moved down an octave and kept monophonic.

name: Low Octave Split
description: The lower hand drops an octave while the upper hand passes through.

name: Quiet Keys Only
description: Keep softly played notes and give them a useful dynamic range.

name: Right Hand Bell
description: Only middle C and above, lifted an octave.

name: Soft Electric Keys
description: A gentle velocity curve that keeps the loudest keys restrained.

name: Staccato Eighths
description: Long notes end after an eighth; short notes keep their articulation.
